content:
karen (sec-eng): Heads-up: bulk SCIM provisioning for tenant acme-corp started failing ~12:08 UTC after a KMS alias swap. SAML logins look fine, but RBAC not applied — users created with no roles.

matt (eng-security): Saw the alert. Can you paste an example of the error trace?

karen (sec-eng): Paste from scim-provision logs: 
```
2026-03-22T12:07:59Z ERROR scim-provision service: decrypt failed alias=projects/acme/locations/global/keyRING/alias/2026-03-22 err=DecryptionError: malformed ciphertext
user_extid=ext-12345
```

samuel (infra): We rotated the KMS alias at 11:50 UTC as part of the rekey. Did we rewrap existing SCIM envelopes? I don't think that's automatic for that key.

ida-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-42, priority=P2 — assigned to @matt and @samuel

matt (eng-security): Quick mitigation proposal: pause RBAC enforcement for new users for tenant acme-corp so they can sign in while we backfill roles. Toggle flag: SCIM_ROLE_ENFORCE=false (tenant-scoped).

lina (devex): Are we comfortable with that temporary risk? Audit will still show decrypt failure events, but users won't be blocked.

karen (sec-eng): Also — avoid data leak. Logs include user emails; redact any stdout files before we ship.

samuel (infra): Commands I'm running to reproduce / inspect: 
```
# test scim push
curl -u "scim-token:x" -X POST https://scim.redwood.internal/v2/Users -d '{"externalId":"ext-999","userName":"test+acme@example.com"}'

# inspect KMS key versions
gcloud kms keys versions list --keyring=prod-kr --location=global --key=scim-enveloping-key
```

matt (eng-security): Root cause hypothesis: rekey created a new key version and alias pointer updated, but some envelopes remained wrapped with the old version. Our unwrap client uses an encryption context shape that changed in the rollout (we added tenant_id and rollout_id). KMS returns MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT when context doesn't match.

karen (sec-eng): Can you grep for mismatched encryptionContext fields in the decrypt logs? If old ciphertext lacks tenant context, that'll confirm.

samuel (infra): Confirmed: multiple decrypt attempts have an empty or missing 'encryptionContext' field. Old wraps didn't include tenant=acme. Rewrap required.

matt (eng-security): Proposed plan: 
- pause RBAC enforcement for acme-corp (tenant flag)
- spawn a one-off rewrap job to: decrypt with legacy key version -> re-encrypt with new context and alias
- run a backfill to reapply roles for recently-created users
- redact any exposed log lines and rotate SCIM tokens if they were in logs
- add fallback in unwrap client: try legacy alias mapping before failing hard
I'll open a PR for the fallback logic and runbook notes.

lina (devex): Ping customer success and advise they may see a short delay in provisioning; ask them not to onboard new users until backfill completes. I'll draft the message.

oncall: I'm on it, drafting the customer-facing message. Any confirmed PII exposure?

karen (sec-eng): Minimal PII (emails) leaked to a debug log on a few hosts. We've started redaction and are rotating SCIM API tokens tied to the pipeline.

ida-bot: Update INC-20260322-42: mitigation started; job queued (job-id=wrp-20260322-7).

samuel (infra): Staging rewrap job completed successfully. Starting prod rewrap with rate limit=200/s; monitoring decrypt error counts and audit stream.

matt (eng-security): Also spotted a vuln-ish finding: some 500 responses included partial stack traces containing user email. Filing a vuln ticket to scrub logs and add sanitization; marking as internal severity 'medium'. Not a public CVE.

karen (sec-eng): After the prod rewrap and role backfill, we re-enabled RBAC enforcement for acme-corp at 13:45 UTC. Post-checks passed.

oncall: Closing notes: runbook updated (scim-kms-rewrap.md) with steps for alias swaps and a suggested fallback; incident closed after 1h healthy checks. :thumbsup:

matt (eng-security): Follow-ups: add automatic rewrap during key rotation or a migration job triggered by alias change; add encryptionContext schema versioning and graceful fallback parsing.

lina (devex): I'll update docs and the customer playbook.

karen (sec-eng): Good job team. Final action items: redact historical logs, rotate any exposed tokens, merge fallback PR, schedule a postmortem doc in the incident ticket.

ida-bot: INC-20260322-42 status -> resolved.
